title: Listing Highlight: 102' Maiora STAMOS BIEN
description: Discover the luxury and elegance of the 2001 Maiora 102 yacht, STAMOS BIEN, featuring breathtaking design, advanced tech, and lavish accommodations.
html:
Exploring the 2001 Maiora 102 Yacht

The Maiora 102, known as STAMOS BIEN, is a vessel that embodies a unique design philosophy, characterized by its recognizable lines and expansive windows. These features create a harmonious connection between the interior and exterior, allowing for uninterrupted views of the surrounding waters. This yacht represents a fusion of architectural elegance and nautical design, making it a standout in its class.

Elegant Design and Exterior Features

The exterior of the Maiora 102 is crafted with attention to detail, featuring a teak deck that has been recently renewed. The flybridge is equipped with a polished aluminum sun cover and a movable sunroof, providing an ideal space for relaxation and entertainment. The vessel is also outfitted with advanced deck equipment, including Lofrans anchor windlasses and a hydraulic crane, ensuring ease of operation and safety.


Luxurious Interior and Accommodations

Inside, the yacht offers accommodations for nine guests across four staterooms, each with its own bathroom. The master stateroom is a luxurious retreat, complete with a king-size bed, a walk-in closet, and a fully marbled bathroom featuring a Jacuzzi. The salon is designed for comfort and entertainment, boasting plush sofas, a wet bar, and a state-of-the-art entertainment system. The dining area is equipped with a large table and ample storage for dinnerware, making it perfect for hosting gatherings.

Advanced Navigation and Pilot House Technology

The pilot house of the Maiora 102 is equipped with cutting-edge navigation technology, including a Garmin electronic package and a Furuno fish finder. The helm station features MTU electronic controls and a comprehensive array of monitoring systems for safe and efficient navigation. The inclusion of a closed-circuit television monitor and a sophisticated communication system ensures that the crew can operate the yacht with precision and confidence.

Comprehensive Deck and Flybridge Amenities

The flybridge is a hub of activity, featuring a helm station with new Garmin navigation equipment, a bar with a refrigerator and ice maker, and a spacious sun lounge area. The aft deck offers additional seating and dining options, with a teak table and a wet bar. The yacht is also equipped with JL Audio speakers throughout, providing a high-quality sound experience for guests.

A Blend of Style and Functionality

The 2001 Maiora 102 is a yacht that seamlessly combines style with functionality. Its design allows for a comfortable and luxurious experience on the water, with advanced technology and thoughtful amenities enhancing every aspect of the journey.
